facts.fact: Veille Citoyenne pour la Bonne Gouvernance says the President remains the only Congolese publicly issued the national ID card; no enrolment count is given, so only a claim of very low coverage, not a figure.

COD.note: No number at birth is stated.
Operation and maintenance of the system are not described.
No register keyed on the ID number is stated.

facts.fact: ONIP handed the first national ID card to the President on 2023-06-30 as the start of a national process; a civil-society group says mass enrolment has not reached provinces such as Tshopo and demands a delivery timetable.
